title: Fixing a Squeaky Door
content:
A squeaky door is a small annoyance that gets louder over time. The good news is that most squeaks are simple friction problems, and you can fix them in minutes.

Start with the easiest checks and work toward deeper fixes only if the sound persists.

Check the hinge screws

Loose screws let the hinge move against the frame. Tighten each screw with a screwdriver. If a screw spins without grabbing, replace it with a slightly longer one.

Clean the hinge

Dust and old oil can build up inside the hinge knuckles. Wipe the hinge with a dry cloth and remove visible grime before you add fresh lubricant.

Lubricate the hinge

Use a light oil, then move the door back and forth to work it in. Wipe away any extra oil so it does not drip onto the floor.

When the hinge pin is stuck

Tap the pin upward with a nail and a small hammer. Pull it out, wipe it clean, apply oil, and slide it back in. This restores smooth movement and removes old grit.

Tools you might need

  • Screwdriver
  • Light oil or silicone spray
  • Small hammer
  • Nail or punch
A quiet door is a small daily relief.

Prevent it from coming back

Check the door once a season and add a drop of oil when the hinge starts to feel dry. Regular care keeps the squeak away.
